results.name: MonomialOrder.sPolynomial_antisymm
results.source_text:
lemma sPolynomial_antisymm (f g : MvPolynomial σ R) :
    m.sPolynomial f g = - m.sPolynomial g f :=
  (neg_sub (_ * g) (_ * f)).symm

results.name: MvPolynomial.IsSymmetric.sub
results.source_text:
theorem sub (hφ : IsSymmetric φ) (hψ : IsSymmetric ψ) : IsSymmetric (φ - ψ) :=
  (symmetricSubalgebra σ R).sub_mem hφ hψ

results.name: dvd_antisymm'
results.source_text:
theorem dvd_antisymm' : a ∣ b → b ∣ a → b = a :=
  flip dvd_antisymm

results.name: MvPolynomial.IsSymmetric
results.source_text:
/-- A `MvPolynomial φ` is symmetric if it is invariant under
permutations of its variables by the `rename` operation -/
def IsSymmetric [CommSemiring R] (φ : MvPolynomial σ R) : Prop :=
  ∀ e : Perm σ, rename e φ = φ
results.docstring:
A `MvPolynomial φ` is symmetric if it is invariant under
permutations of its variables by the `rename` operation

results.name: QuantumMechanics.SpaceDHilbertSpace.PolyBddSchwartzSubmodule.antitone
results.source_text:
lemma antitone (d : ℕ) {a b : ℕ∞} (h : a ≤ b) :
    PolyBddSchwartzSubmodule d b ≤ PolyBddSchwartzSubmodule d a := by
  simp only [PolyBddSchwartzSubmodule, polyBddSchwartzIncl,
    ContinuousLinearMap.toLinearMap_domRestrict, LinearMap.range_domRestrict]
  exact Submodule.map_mono (PolyBddSchwartzMap_antitone d h)

results.name: PureU1.VectorLikeEvenPlane.P!_accCube
results.source_text:
lemma P!_accCube (f : Fin n → ℚ) : accCube (2 * n.succ) (P! f) = 0 := by
  rw [accCube_explicit, sum_evenShift, P!_evenShiftZero, P!_evenShiftLast]
  simp only [ne_eq, OfNat.ofNat_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true, zero_pow, add_zero, Function.comp_apply,
    zero_add]
  refine Finset.sum_eq_zero fun i _ => ?_
  simp only [P!_evenShiftFst, P!_evenShiftSnd]
  ring

results.name: Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le
results.source_text:
lemma eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le {p q : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic)
    (hq : q.Monic) (hdvd : p ∣ q) (hdeg : q.natDegree ≤ p.natDegree) : q = p := by
  rw [eq_mul_leadingCoeff_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le hp hdvd hdeg]
  simp [hq]

results.name: Polynomial.monic_of_degree_le
results.source_text:
theorem monic_of_degree_le (n : ℕ) (pn : p.degree ≤ n) (p1 : p.coeff n = 1) : Monic p :=
  monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one n (natDegree_le_of_degree_le pn) p1

results.name: Polynomial.monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one
results.source_text:
theorem monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one (n : ℕ) (pn : p.natDegree ≤ n) (p1 : p.coeff n = 1) :
    Monic p := by
  unfold Monic
  nontriviality
  refine (congr_arg _ <| natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero pn ?_).trans p1
  exact ne_of_eq_of_ne p1 one_ne_zero

results.name: Polynomial.eq_natDegree_of_le_mem_support
results.source_text:
theorem eq_natDegree_of_le_mem_support (pn : p.natDegree ≤ n) (ns : n ∈ p.support) :
    p.natDegree = n :=
  le_antisymm pn (le_natDegree_of_mem_supp _ ns)

results.name: Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_associated
results.source_text:
theorem eq_of_monic_of_associated (hp : p.Monic) (hq : q.Monic) (hpq : Associated p q) : p = q := by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hpq
  rw [(hp.of_mul_monic_left hq).eq_one_of_isUnit u.isUnit, mul_one]

results.name: Polynomial.Monic.sub_of_left
results.source_text:
theorem Monic.sub_of_left {p q : R[X]} (hp : Monic p) (hpq : degree q < degree p) :
    Monic (p - q) := by
  rw [sub_eq_add_neg]
  apply hp.add_of_left
  rwa [degree_neg]

results.name: Polynomial.monic_prod_of_monic
results.source_text:
theorem monic_prod_of_monic (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → R[X]) (hs : ∀ i ∈ s, Monic (f i)) :
    Monic (∏ i ∈ s, f i) :=
  monic_multiset_prod_of_monic s.1 f hs

results.name: Polynomial.degree_eq_degree_of_associated
results.source_text:
theorem degree_eq_degree_of_associated (h : Associated p q) : degree p = degree q := by
  let ⟨u, hu⟩ := h
  simp [hu.symm]
